module: World Editor DataBlock (SimDataBlock) editor, accessible through the Assets > "DataBlock Editor" menu. Two-tab window: "Existing" (tree of datablocks grouped by class, with a * for modified datablocks, Save and Delete buttons) and "New" (choice of a class then a "Create new DataBlock" window with name and optional copy of the values of an existing datablock). Field editing is done in the standard inspector; the extension marks the datablock as modified when a field changes. Also adds editor.openDatablockEditor(dataBlockId, previousInspectorObjectId) to open the editor from another tool.
notes: Creation, deletion and saving go through editor.history (undo possible) and the functions editor.createDataBlock, removeDataBlockFromFile, saveDataBlockToFile, saveDirtyDataBlock.
After deletion, a window states that the datablock is removed from its file and will cease to exist at restart.
The class list is rebuilt at initialization then when the size of Sim.getDataBlockSet() changes and the window is visible.
Class names are extracted from enumerateConsoleClasses("SimDataBlock") with the pattern %a+: a name containing a digit or an underscore would be truncated (inferred from code).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame: draws the DataBlock Editor window, the creation window and the deletion confirmation if the window is visible.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at World Editor initialization: adds the menu entry (Assets group), registers the "dataBlockEditor" and "createDataBlock" windows, loads the class list and defines editor.openDatablockEditor.

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.desc: Hook called when a field is modified in the inspector; if the first selected object is a datablock, marks it as modified (editor.setDataBlockDirty).

onEditorInspectorHeaderGui.desc: Hook called to draw the inspector header; if a datablock is selected after a call to openDatablockEditor, shows the "<< Back To Previously Selected Object" button that restores the previous selection.

onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.desc: Hook called when the object selection changes; forgets the previously selected object for the "Back" button.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is loaded; writes "initialized" to the log.
